snippet.title: Ground Water - Episode of Dhanra: Official Steam Next Fest Trailer
snippet.description:
A platformer about squeezing and a quest to forge freedom from @Skysmith-Studios . Follow Roshi's venture through the conflicts of Dhanra Village as a part of his journey to find a cure for the curse on him and his home. Navigate through the winding paths and tactile environments that help express Roshi's potent squeeze and vessels.

Download the Demo Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3264550/Ground_Water__Episode_of_Dhanra_Demo/

Wishlist the Full Game:
